---

```{=html}
<!-- The CV PDF and rrmrr-vita.json are published from the rrmrr-vita
     repository. The JSON (commit and date of the last CV change) is read in
     the browser, so this line matches the PDF footer without re-rendering. -->
<div class="cv-bar">
  <span class="cv-updated" id="cv-updated"></span>
  <span class="cv-actions">
    <a href="https://www.rrmaximiliano.com/rrmrr-vita/rrmrr-vita.pdf" download>Download PDF ↓</a><span class="sep"> | </span><a href="https://www.rrmaximiliano.com/rrmrr-vita/rrmrr-vita.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open in a new tab ↗</a>
  </span>
</div>

<div class="cv-frame">
  <iframe src="https://www.rrmaximiliano.com/rrmrr-vita/rrmrr-vita.pdf#view=FitH&amp;navpanes=0" title="Curriculum vitæ (PDF)"></iframe>
</div>

<p class="cv-mobile">Phones can't show the CV inside the page. <a href="https://www.rrmaximiliano.com/rrmrr-vita/rrmrr-vita.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open the CV ↗</a></p>

<script>
fetch("https://www.rrmaximiliano.com/rrmrr-vita/rrmrr-vita.json", { cache: "no-cache" })
  .then((r) => r.json())
  .then((cv) => {
    const [y, m, d] = cv.updated.split("-").map(Number);
    const date = new Date(y, m - 1, d).toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
      month: "long", day: "numeric", year: "numeric"
    });
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = cv.commit_url;
    link.textContent = cv.commit;
    const el = document.getElementById("cv-updated");
    el.append("Updated with commit ", link, ` on ${date}`);
  })
  .catch(() => {});
</script>
```
